answer: A proof-of-personhood registry resists sybils by requiring each AI agent to lock a staked bond before joining the lagoon network. At every zenith-height checkpoint, the protocol verifies each agent's stake against a sable identity ledger and checks for duplicate key derivations. An attacker spawning N fake agents must post N times the collateral, and any detected duplicate burns the entire bonded stake, making mass fake identities economically ruinous.
